flagged.title: Settings & Symbolism
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims on screen and in voiceover that Satis House was consumed and destroyed by fire (F6), a classic plot misconception that would penalise a student's AO1 textual knowledge in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: Satis House is destroyed twice: first by fire, then demolished and sold.

flagged.title: Key Themes & Exam Technique
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes the novel's famous line 'Suffering has been stronger than all other teaching' to Pip, whereas the lesson and novel explicitly state this is spoken by Estella.

mark_affecting.video_says: I want to start with this incredibly powerful quotation from Pip: 'Suffering has been stronger than all other teaching.'
mark_affecting.lesson_says: Estella’s closing line captures this perfectly: 'Suffering has been stronger than all other teaching.' [...] (Estella — applies equally to Pip’s arc).
